📌 今日英语任务
✅ 四级英语：List 1
✅ 考研单词：新40 + 旧100
✅ 多邻国：1个小单元打卡
📖 30天趣味记忆·第1篇
第1篇 English Passage: On a quiet morning, Lily decided to abandon her lazy habit and pursue a meaningful goal. She opened a thick dictionary and began to memorize words with persistent effort. Some terms were abstract, such as justice and liberty; others were concrete, like vessel and timber. She did not merely recite them. Instead, she composed a short essay, trying to integrate each word into a coherent context. Her friend Jack, a diligent student, often emphasized that vocabulary is the foundation of language. He would quote an ancient proverb: “A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.” Lily also learned to distinguish subtle differences among synonyms, such as ignore and neglect, or fragile and brittle. Whenever she felt weary, she would recall her ambition and regain momentum. She kept a notebook to record unfamiliar expressions, including phrases like comply with, deprive of, and incline to. Gradually, her reading speed accelerated, and her comprehension became more accurate. She realized that language learning is not a transient task but a long-term investment. With patience and discipline, she could overcome obstacles and achieve remarkable progress. By the end of the month, she had acquired a sizable vocabulary and felt more confident in expressing her thoughts. 中文翻译： 在一个安静的早晨，莉莉决定抛弃懒惰的习惯，追求一个有意义的目标。她打开一本厚厚的词典，开始以坚持不懈的努力记忆单词。有些词是抽象的，如正义和自由；有些则是具体的，如容器和木材。她不只是背诵它们。相反，她写了一段短文，试图把每个词融入一个连贯的语境中。她的朋友杰克是个勤奋的学生，常常强调词汇是语言的基础。他会引用一句古老的谚语：“千里之行，始于足下。”莉莉还学会了区分同义词之间的细微差别，比如ignore和neglect，或者fragile和brittle。每当她感到疲倦时，她就会想起自己的抱负，重新获得动力。她保留一个笔记本，记录不熟悉的表达，包括像comply with、deprive of和incline to这样的短语。渐渐地，她的阅读速度加快了，理解也变得更准确。她意识到语言学习不是一时的任务，而是长期的投资。凭借耐心和自律，她能够克服障碍，取得显著进步。到月底时，她已经掌握了相当多的词汇，并对表达自己的思想更有信心。 重点词汇列表（30个）： abandon, pursue, persistent, abstract, justice, liberty, concrete, vessel, timber, recite, compose, integrate, coherent, diligent, emphasize, foundation, quote, proverb, distinguish, subtle, ignore, neglect, fragile, brittle, weary, ambition, momentum, comply, deprive, incline
✅ 每日自测
一、中译英 1. 她决定抛弃懒惰的习惯，追求一个有意义的目标。 2. 词汇是语言的基础。 3. 她意识到语言学习不是一时的任务，而是长期的投资。 二、英译中 1. She composed a short essay and tried to integrate each word into a coherent context. 2. He would quote an ancient proverb: “A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.” 3. With patience and discipline, she could overcome obstacles and achieve remarkable progress. 三、句子填空 1. She did not merely recite them; instead, she tried to ______ each word into a coherent context. 2. Whenever she felt weary, she would recall her ambition and regain ______.

📌 今日英语任务
✅ 四级英语：List 1
✅ 考研单词：新40 + 旧100

📖 30天趣味记忆·第1篇
第1篇 On a quiet autumn morning, Lin decided to abandon the habit of putting things off. He had long pursued a vague dream of becoming a writer, but his desk was covered with dusty notes and half-finished drafts. His teacher once said that a persistent mind could turn abstract ideas into concrete progress. Lin also remembered a proverb: justice and liberty are precious, but they require daily effort. So he began to recite a short passage every day, compose a paragraph, and integrate new words into his journal. At first his writing was not coherent, and he often felt weary. Yet he refused to ignore small mistakes or neglect basic practice. He learned to distinguish subtle differences between synonyms, and he tried not to be fragile or brittle when criticism came. His ambition slowly gained momentum. He would comply with a simple rule: write for thirty minutes before breakfast. This choice did not deprive him of rest; instead, it inclined him to think more clearly. By the end of the month, his foundation had grown stronger, and he felt ready to share his first essay with others. 中文翻译 在一个安静的秋日早晨，林决定放弃拖延的习惯。他长久以来一直追求一个模糊的作家梦，但书桌上堆满了落灰的笔记和未完成的草稿。他的老师曾说，坚持不懈的心能把抽象的想法变成具体的进步。林还记得一句谚语：正义与自由很珍贵，但它们需要每日的努力。于是他开始每天背诵一段短文，写一段话，并把新词融入日记。起初他的文章并不连贯，他也常常感到疲惫。但他拒绝忽视小错误，也不愿疏于基础练习。他学会辨别同义词之间细微的差别，并努力在批评来临时不脆弱、不轻易崩溃。他的雄心慢慢积聚起势头。他愿意遵守一个简单的规则：早饭前写三十分钟。这个选择并没有剥夺他的休息；反而使他更倾向于清晰地思考。到月底，他的基础变得更扎实，他觉得可以把自己的第一篇文章分享给别人了。 重点词汇列表 abandon, pursue, persistent, abstract, justice, liberty, concrete, recite, compose, integrate, coherent, weary, ignore, neglect, distinguish, subtle, fragile, brittle, ambition, momentum, comply, deprive, incline, foundation, vague, dusty, draft, synonym, criticism, clearly
✅ 每日自测
一、中译英 1. 他决定放弃拖延的习惯。 2. 坚持不懈的心能把抽象的想法变成具体的进步。 3. 他学会辨别同义词之间细微的差别。 二、英译中 1. He had long pursued a vague dream of becoming a writer. 2. His ambition slowly gained momentum. 3. This choice did not deprive him of rest. 三、句子填空 1. He tried not to be fragile or ______ when criticism came. 2. By the end of the month, his ______ had grown stronger.

📖 30天趣味记忆·第2篇
第2篇 English: Once there was a diligent young man named Leo who lived in a dusty village. He had a strong ambition to pursue knowledge, though his family was poor. Every morning, he would recite English passages aloud, trying to compose coherent sentences. His teacher often emphasized that one should not neglect the foundation of grammar, nor ignore the subtle differences between synonyms. Leo felt weary at times, but he refused to abandon his dream. He would draft essays on timber tables, and though criticism was harsh, he remained persistent. One day, he received a fragile old book about liberty and justice. The abstract ideas seemed vague at first, but he did not comply with despair. Instead, he began to integrate concrete examples into his notes. He learned to distinguish between right and wrong, and to overcome every obstacle. His momentum grew, and he became a vessel of hope for his village. He would quote a proverb: “Where there is a will, there is a way.” His story shows that if you incline your heart toward progress, you can deprive fear of its power and build a solid foundation for the future. 中文翻译： 从前有一个勤奋的年轻人叫利奥，住在一个尘土飞扬的村庄里。他雄心勃勃，渴望追求知识，尽管家境贫寒。每天早晨，他都会大声背诵英语文章，努力写出连贯的句子。他的老师经常强调，一个人不应忽视语法基础，也不应忽略同义词之间的细微差别。利奥有时感到疲惫，但他拒绝放弃梦想。他会在木桌上打草稿，尽管批评很严厉，他仍然坚持不懈。一天，他收到一本关于自由与正义的脆弱旧书。这些抽象概念起初似乎很模糊，但他没有向绝望妥协。相反，他开始将具体例子融入笔记。他学会了辨别是非，克服每一个障碍。他的势头日益增长，成为村里希望的容器。他会引用一句谚语：“有志者事竟成。”他的故事表明，如果你把心倾向进步，就能剥夺恐惧的力量，为未来打下坚实的基础。 重点词汇列表（30个）： diligent, dusty, ambition, pursue, recite, compose, coherent, emphasize, neglect, ignore, subtle, synonym, weary, abandon, draft, timber, criticism, persistent, fragile, liberty, justice, abstract, vague, comply, integrate, concrete, distinguish, momentum, vessel, incline, deprive, foundation, quote, proverb
✅ 每日自测
一、中译英： 1. 他勤奋学习，追求知识。 2. 不要忽视语法基础。 3. 他拒绝放弃梦想。 二、英译中： 1. subtle 2. coherent 3. momentum 三、句子填空： 1. He would _____ English passages aloud every morning. 2. His teacher often _____ the importance of grammar.

📖 30天趣味记忆·第4篇
第4篇 English: On a dusty morning, the weary but diligent researcher did not abandon her ambition to pursue justice and liberty. She knew that fragile criticism could make a brittle mind break, so she chose to compose a coherent argument that would emphasize concrete evidence rather than neglect subtle details. She would recite her draft aloud to distinguish vague ideas from clear ones and to integrate every timber of truth into a sturdy vessel of thought. My ambition was not grand: to finish a coherent draft about local timber crafts before the foundation of winter. The villagers were diligent but fragile in health; their criticism of modern life was subtle, never vague. I tried to compose a concrete plan, yet I could not ignore a persistent doubt. One old carpenter, whose hands were brittle from age, taught me to distinguish good wood from bad. He would recite a proverb: “A vessel is shaped by patience, not by force.” I began to integrate his advice, though I felt deprived of momentum. He did not neglect small details; he would incline his head and comply with the wood’s nature. I watched him quote an abstract idea into daily practice. A cluster of moist moss grew on his roof, and the fragrance of pine filled the air. Through binoculars, I saw a bird abandon its liberty for a moment of rest. Justice, I thought, is not always loud. Sometimes it is a quiet transition—like a soft dissolve between two scenes. That winter, I learned that even a broken piece can find its place. 中文翻译: 去年秋天，我带着满是灰尘的背包和疲惫的心，走进一个偏僻的山村。我的抱负并不宏大：在冬季来临之前，完成一篇关于当地木工手艺的连贯草稿。村民们勤劳但身体脆弱；他们对现代生活的批评含蓄而不模糊。我试图构思一个具体的计划，却无法忽视一种持续存在的疑虑。一位年迈的木匠，双手因年岁而脆弱，教我分辨好木材与坏木材。他会背诵一句谚语：“器皿由耐心塑造，而非强力。”我开始整合他的建议，尽管感到失去了动力。他没有忽视细微之处；他会偏过头，顺应木头的本性。我看他把抽象的理念引用到日常实践中。他屋顶上长着一簇湿润的苔藓，空气中弥漫着松树的芬芳。透过双筒望远镜，我看见一只鸟暂时放弃自由，稍作休息。我想，正义并不总是喧哗的。有时它是一次安静的过渡——像两个场景之间柔和的溶解。那个冬天，我明白即使破碎之物也能找到自己的位置。 重点词汇列表（30个）: 1. dusty 2. weary 3. solitary 4. ambition 5. coherent 6. draft 7. timber 8. foundation 9. diligent 10. fragile 11. criticism 12. subtle 13. vague 14. compose 15. concrete 16. ignore 17. persistent 18. brittle 19. distinguish 20. recite 21. proverb 22. vessel 23. integrate 24. deprive 25. momentum 26. neglect 27. incline 28. comply 29. quote 30. abstract （滚动复习词：dusty, weary, solitary, ambition, coherent, draft, timber, foundation, diligent, fragile, criticism, subtle, vague, compose, concrete, ignore, persistent, brittle, distinguish, recite, proverb, vessel, integrate, deprive, momentum, neglect, incline, comply, quote, abstract）
